proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ a b c
  simp only [sq]
  exact EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_sub_two_mul_dist_mul_dist_mul_cos_angle a b c
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (a b c : P), dist a c ^ 2 = dist a b ^ 2 + dist c b ^ 2 - 2 * dist a b * dist c b * Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle a b c)
